CharacterDescription: Roose Bolton is the Lord of the Dreadfort and head of House Bolton - the most feared and most quietly dangerous lord in the North. He practices leeching for his health and is known as the Leech Lord. He is pale, soft-spoken, and utterly without the bluster Northern lords typically use. He does not need bluster. His eyes are pale and cold. He speaks so quietly people lean forward to hear him which is exactly where he wants them. He is calculating in ways that go past what anyone around him realizes. He holds the custom of the first night over his smallfolk, illegal by the realm's law and practiced at the Dreadfort with characteristic indifference. He is marching with Robb Stark. He is always calculating the next move.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Known as the 'Leech Lord' as he sees leeching as a means to stay healthy. He is known to practice the 'the first night' which is outlawed in the Seven Kingdoms, but was a First Man tradition.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: Marching with Robb Stark's forces in the Riverlands two days before Ned Stark's execution. Calculating.
